DILG Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT DILG-NAPOLCOM Center, EDSA comer ouezon Avenue. West Triangle. Quezon City http:/fwww.dilq.com.ph DILG OPINION No. 71 s. 2021 28 May 2021 MR. MONTANO GENEROSO MERCADO Former Chairman Board of Directors Dolores Water District Municipality of Dolores Province of Quezon Dear Mr. Mercado: This has reference to your letter dated 12 February 2021 requesting for this Department's legal opinion concerning the propriety of the actions of the Sangguniang Bayan of Dolores, Province of Quezon, vis-ä-vis its order for the discontinuance of the implementation of the water system project being undertaken by the IJDENNA Water Integrated Services thereat. As culled from your letter and its attachments, the Sangguniang Bayan (SB) of Dolores, Quezon passed Resolution No. 172-2020 authorizing Municipal Mayor Orlan A. Calayag to represent the Municipality of Dolores in filing appropriate case before the proper court in relation to the Water Supply Agreement between the Dolores Water District (DWD) and San Pablo City Water District (SPCWD). It is alleged, among others, that the said Agreement between the DWD and SPCWD failed to take into account the existing water problem of Dolores as well as the projected future demand due to ever increasing population and continuing eco-religious tourism development of the Dolores. Further, it is alleged that such Agreement will deprive the people of Dolores of its basic natural resource and cause irreparable damage and injury to Lumbo Springs water supply.

Moreover, it is also alleged that the project of Udenna Water Integrated Services was bidded and awarded without the required coordination with the concemed local govemment units. Conversely, perusal of the letter of Mr. Percy R. Gaurano, General Manager, DWD, addressed to Mayor Calayag, it appears that there was a consultation and hearing made before the herein concerned Sangguniang and the general public thereat. It is also mentioned in the said letter that the requirements and legal procedure during the bidding process of Lumbao Bulk Water Supply Project was strictly followed through the guidance of the National Economic and Development Authority and the Office of the Govemment Corporate Counsel. As such, Mr. Gaurano is of the position that "all actions or activities of DWD was (sic) legal and proper." Hence, the subject letter-request for opinion on the propriety of the actions of herein concerned Sangguniang. At the outset, we regret to inform that this Department is constrained from rendering its opinion on the instant controversy considering that the same involves contradicting claims and is justiciable in nature. Moreover, this is also in light of the Department's Memorandum Order No. 2010-02 dated 17 September 2010, which provides: "xxx all concemed are hereby advised that the Department shall not act on queries of the following kinds, to wit: 1. Those containing facts that are Justifiable in nature. Justiciable issues are those that require adjudication by the courts of law as to who between the opposing parties have the better right over a given controversy; 2. Those presumptively valid acts; e.g., enacted ordinance, consummated acts that already enjoy the presumption of regularity on the part of the public officer concerned, and similar instances; 3. Those that are litis pendencia or pending litigation, except when the court itself, requests for opinion. In the event that the opinion has been rendered by the Department and its field officers without knowledge or the information that a case involving the issues raised in the query is pending in court, such opinion shall automatically be deemed ineffective ; and 4. Those that are cognizable by other agencies of the govemment."

Notwithstanding, for purposes of academic discussion coupled with our objective to guide the concerned on the proper course of action to take under the circumstances, we deemed it necessary to indulge in disquisition on the matter. Well-settled is the rule that existing contracts between the parties are presumed valid and shall be respected. Hence, unless the agreement is invalidated by the proper forum, the same must be given force and effect. We maintain our view that water districts, once formed are not under the jurisdiction of any political subdivision. These agencies enjoy operational autonomy, independent of local governments. The foregoing discussion is not in any way intended to rule on the validity of the subject Resolution. Let it be emphasized that the propriety of a resolutions and ordinances passed by sanggunjan must properly be questioned before the regular court. This opinion is being rendered without prejudice to any contrary opinion of competent authorities and the courts. We hope to have assisted you accordingly. Thank you. Very truly yours, BY AU H RITY OF THE SECRETARY: AN, CESO Ill y for Local Government LLLS'27 Copy furnished: DIR. ARIEL O. IGLESIA Regiona Director, DILG-Region IV-A (CALABARZON) 3rd Floor, Anderson Bldg. l, Brgy. Parian Calamba City
